description: Figure 3, titled "Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev," is a grouped bar chart comparing the execution accuracy of two logical synthesis modules, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four different levels of query difficulty: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents "Execution Accuracy" with a scale from 20 to 60. For each difficulty level, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL. The chart displays the following values: on Simple queries, NatSQL achieves 60.21% and TA-SQL achieves 63.14%. On Moderate queries, NatSQL achieves 39.64% and TA-SQL achieves 48.60%. On Challenging queries, NatSQL achieves 32.32% and TA-SQL achieves 36.11%. For the Total, the values are 51.35% for NatSQL and 56.19% for TA-SQL. The legend at the top right identifies the light blue bars as NatSQL and the dark blue bars as TA-SQL.
